messages:
Priya: Kicking off BlueLeaf POC prep. Customer wants a 30m sustained run at 520 qps (mix: 70% chat, 30% embeddings) with two 20s microbursts to 1k qps. Need final runbook, cost estimate, and a short security note for their compliance team.
Liam: model pin? quant? deployment?
Priya: pin rdx/chat-xt-1 + rdx/embed-lite as a combo, quant 8-bit where supported. Running on Dedicated pool in eu-central. cache-prefix enabled TTL=420s. Warmup: 10m to 520 qps.
Hannah: ops recs: 3 nodes (each A100x1 equiv), autoscale min=2 max=5, prefer continuous batching. Split batches: embed_size=64, chat_size=24. Disable noisy-neighbor throttling for the window.
OpsBot: suggested command:
```
rdx-load --mix chat:0.7,embed:0.3 --target 520 --burst 1000:00:00:20 --ramp 00:10:00 --duration 00:30:00 \
  --model-pair rdx/chat-xt-1,rdx/embed-lite --quant 8bit --cache-ttl 420
```
Liam: quick cost estimate? buyer needs a ballpark to approve infra spend.
Priya: rough tokens calc: assume avg 8 tokens per chat response, embeddings billed per call. tokens = 520 * 1800 * 0.7 * 8 ≈ 5,251,200 tokens. at $0.00046/token ≈ $2,415. Embeddings: 520*1800*0.3 ≈ 280,800 embeds * $0.00018 ≈ $50. Ops/support + dashboards + margins => propose $3.5k for the run.
Hannah: dry-run metrics (from yesterday): chat p50=60ms p95=240ms p99=610ms; embeds p50=15ms p95=55ms p99=140ms. We saw 3% 5xx during a 12s microburst when queue latency exceeded 1.8s. Recommend circuit-breaker=1.2s soft-reject.
SecBot: security notes: NDA signed, KMS in eu-central-1, SOC2 provided (redacted). They asked about log retention and whether ephemeral traces can be disabled; we can disable traces and provide redacted metrics. HSM not required for POC.
Priya: any enterprise blockers?
Liam: SOC2 ok, legal wants a short annex on log redaction. Network team requested source IP allowlist: 13.79.18.0/28 — ops, can we add?
Hannah: yes, will add allowlist and open a dashboard share link. I'll stream /metrics and set alert if 5xx > 2% for 2m.
Priya: Great. Action items: Liam->formal quote, Hannah->runbook + dashboard + allowlist, SecBot->log annex. Run scheduled for 1769123456 08:30 CET. Post-run debrief 20m after. :white_check_mark:
